skills.name: Unnatural Death
skills.text: When another character dies, Cao Pi can choose to take all of their cards.

skills.name: Exile
skills.text: When Cao Pi is damaged, he can choose any character (other than himself) and force them to flip their character card. The flipped character then draws X cards, where X is the difference between Cao Pi's maximum health level and his current health level after the damage was inflicted.

skills.name: Exaltation
skills.text: King Ability: When a Wei character flips a black judgement card, they can allow Cao Pi to draw a card.

source.site: English Sanguosha (Jason Keeney and Scott Maresh)
